data_evidence.role: exact finite hidden-support scaling examples and counterwitnesses

exact_consequences: A symmetric four-hidden-parse configuration has target overt probability 1/2 at every scale.

A three-correct-versus-one-better-wrong multiplicity configuration has probability 3/(3+exp(t)): it is a strict 3/5 success at the positive scale log(2), crosses 1/2 at log(3), and tends to zero under further common scaling.
For fixed finite positive masses and a strict target-versus-wrong Harmony gap, the wrong probability obeys the stated exponential envelope.
The complete fixed-support theorem licenses convergence to one only when every global hidden maximizer lies in the target overt fibre.
